title: Clinical development in primary mitochondrial diseases at a translational inflection point: Lessons, mechanisms, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
intervention: mitochondria-targeted therapies for primary mitochondrial diseases (review of clinical trial landscape; e.g., idebenone, taurine, doxribtimine, elamipretide)

outcomes.name: PMD clinical trial landscape (ClinicalTrials.gov survey, Jan 2010-Apr 2026)
